args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy of `checkout-api` (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version that was healthy in production — in all three regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: the service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` (paged the on-call engineer) documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and the verified recovery.
